# Good Display

[GDEY0213B74](gdey0213b74/preset.json) and [GDEY0213F51](gdey0213f51/preset.json) provide full-refresh presets and runnable energy-operation parts (engine 0.2.3+), with deep sleep between updates. Characterization retains source revisions, conditions, physical pin names and unknown modes. See the [comparison and source limitations](../../docs/EINK-DATASHEETS.md).
